summary.zh: 更快的治疗波、施法时保留一半的法力回复，再加 20 级的水之护盾。
summary.en: A faster Healing Wave, half your Mana regeneration kept while casting, and Water Shield at 20.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，在 Beta 地下城中治疗

pros.zh: 强化治疗波让主力治疗的施法时间缩短 0.5 秒。
pros.en: Improved Healing Wave cuts 0.5 seconds from your main heal.

pros.zh: 全神贯注让 50% 的法力回复在施法时继续生效，这个等级下它比任何治疗量天赋都更有用。
pros.en: Mindfulness keeps 50% of your Mana regeneration running while you cast, which at this level beats any throughput talent.

pros.zh: 水之护盾在你被击中或治疗法术暴击时回复 2% 最大法力，单刷和坦克挨打都能为你回蓝。
pros.en: Water Shield restores 2% of maximum Mana when you are hit or when one of your heals crits, so solo play and tank damage both feed your Mana pool.

pros.zh: 自然优雅是可调整的 2 点：坦克稳当时，图腾集中或先祖治疗比 10% 仇恨降低更有价值。
pros.en: Natural Grace is the flexible pair of points: with a steady tank, Totemic Focus or Ancestral Healing do more than 10% less threat.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
provenance.notes: Beta build 1.60.1.70425 recommendations; may change before launch.
